title: Saying Not now to a weak muscle on one screen does not quiet the same advice on the other
what: Two features point at the same under-trained muscle: the Balance check card on the Charts page and the muscle tip on the Workout tab's Up next card. Each keeps its own Not now list. A member who taps Not now (or I skip this on purpose, or turns muscle tips off) on the Workout tab still sees the Charts card name that muscle, and Not now on the Charts card leaves the Workout tab tip in place.
expected: Putting a muscle away in one place puts it away in both, for the same length of time, and turning muscle tips off also quiets the Charts card.
who: members with 4+ weeks of their own workouts
how_often: every time a muscle is put away in one place
fix_line: Keep one list of put-away muscles and have both the Charts card and the Up next tip read it

items.reason: No send, push, digest or server job starts in this area. The automatic actions are on the member's own phone: the quiet install of a downloaded update (shown afterwards by the New in this version card) and the watch update pop-up's show/no-show decision, which is written with its reason to the watch log. Coach chat is hidden.
Rule applied: each automatic action above leaves a trace the member sees or a logged reason; none is one the owner believes ran.

Pairs found: Backups moved card vs Only on this phone card (same sign-in ask); phone update screen vs watch update pop-up; What's new card vs update screen vs New dots; Charts Balance check vs Up next muscle tip; watch install card vs watch update pop-up.

The Workout tab draws one notice at a time and rests the offers a day after one is closed, so the two sign-in cards never stack. What's new hides while a newer version waits. Two disagreements: the muscle put-away lists, and the watch pop-up waiting on a put-off phone update (already filed).

Every mark here is kept on this phone only: Backups moved seen, Hide for 30 days, watch card Not now, What's new seen, New dots seen, watch Later, Balance check Not now (in the phone database, carried by backups), muscle tip Not now (a separate phone store).
No server send, bell or other device counts these items; the only second place is the Up next muscle tip, which does not read the Charts card's mark.
Rule applied to the muscle put-away marks.

Items that point at a thing to act on: the two sign-in cards, watch install card, update screen and line, What's new, New dots, the Couldn't save banner, Balance check. All decide again on each visit from the real state.

Signing in elsewhere removes both sign-in cards (account read on every visit); installing the watch app removes the watch card (Wear OS asked on every visit); opening a feature's page clears its dots; the next good save removes the Couldn't save banner.
Rule applied: every item above learns its thing was handled; no item is stuck.
